verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the sun and his early morning splendour,
verse.verse_2: And the moon as she follows in his wake,
verse.verse_3: The day when it reveals his radiance,
verse.verse_4: The night when it covers him over,
verse.verse_6: The earth and its spreading out,
verse.verse_7: The soul and how it was integrated
verse.verse_8: And given the faculty of knowing what is disruptive and what is intrinsic to it.
verse.verse_9: He who nourishes it will surely be successful,
verse.verse_10: And he who confines it will surely come to grief.
verse.verse_11: The Thamud denied (the truth) in their perverseness
verse.verse_12: When among them the great wretch arose,
verse.verse_13: And the apostle of God had to tell them: "This is God's she-camel, let her drink."
verse.verse_14: But they called him a liar and hamstrung her. So God obliterated them for their crime, and (destroyed) all of them alike.
verse.verse_15: He does not fear the consequence.
